scopeBoundary: Only preflight ADOPT records tokyo-wave3-0646, tokyo-wave3-1115, and tokyo-wave3-0101 were refreshed and transcribed. No new candidate evidence or ordinary discovery was performed.
policyBasis: Each source was read from the current/current-linked issuer materials in two separate visual passes. The second pass did not use the first-pass ranges as its answer key. A PASS requires a lossless match of printed row/block ownership, number sequences and gaps, issuer subtotals, and representative scope. Published capacity was never used to fit an incomplete set.
